notes: Rule 47: where the head noun is a construct that can take no article, the present article on its attributive takes the phrase's the before a supplied one does. בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ הָעֶלְיוֹן → 'the upper house of the king' gives the first the to הָ on עֶלְיוֹן and leaves בֵּית bare, exactly as NEH.3.30 reads בֶּן־צָלָף הַשִּׁשִּׁי → 'the sixth son of Zalaph'. The accepted alignment supplied the the on בֵּית and left the attributive's article unrepresented.
